tagline: 宝丽来旁轴相机，1965 年发布
description: 宝丽来于1965年推出的旁轴相机。

specs.英文简介:
Part of the series of Polaroid cameras that began with the Automatic Land Camera 100 and finishing at the Automatic Land Camera 450, the Polaroid Land Model 103 shares with all models in this line:
* Folding bellows
* Automatic exposure
* 100-series Packfilm

The 103 is one of the earliest 'consumer' models of the 100-400 series line of folding Packfilm Land Cameras, similar to many other models;
